title: 2x Sunflower ‘Ruby Eclipse’ Mini Plug Plants | Dramatic Red Flowers | Unusual
description:
Transform Your Garden with 'Ruby Eclipse'

 Add a touch of moody elegance to your outdoor space with the stunning Sunflower ‘Ruby Eclipse’. This variety produces breathtaking, deep ruby-red blooms with striking dark centers, offering a sophisticated alternative to the traditional yellow sunflower.


 You are purchasing 2 healthy mini plug plants. These are ready to be potted on or planted out after the last frost. Whether you are looking for a tall focal point in a border or a reliable source for a cutting garden, 'Ruby Eclipse' is a vigorous and high-impact choice.


 Why Choose 'Ruby Eclipse'?

    Unique Color:
   
   Large, velvety ruby-red petals that stand out in any landscape.
  


    Tall & Dramatic:
   
   Reaches impressive heights, perfect for the back of borders or creating natural screens.
  


    Pollinator Friendly:
   
   Highly attractive to bees and butterflies throughout the summer months.
  


    Excellent Cut Flower:
   
   Features long, sturdy stems that are ideal for floral arrangements.
  


    Beginner Friendly:
   
   A reliable and easy-to-grow variety that thrives with minimal fuss.
  


 Quick Facts

    Quantity:
   
   2 Mini Plug Plants
  


    Sunlight:
   
   Full Sun
  


    Flowering Period:
   
   Summer to Early Autumn
  


    Mature Height:
   
   Approximately 1.5m – 2m
  


 Shipping & Care

 Your plants will be securely packaged to arrive in great condition. Once they arrive, please pot them into small containers with fresh compost and keep them well-watered in a bright spot before moving them to their final position in the garden.


   Note:
  
  To encourage multiple flower heads rather than one single large bloom, you can pinch out the growing tip when the plant reaches 30cm in height.
